entry.en: Malta follows Schengen rules, so the passport must have been issued less than 10 years before arrival.
entry.es: Malta sigue las normas Schengen, por lo que el pasaporte debe haberse emitido menos de 10 años antes de la llegada.
entry.quote: have a ‘date of issue’ less than 10 years before the date you arrive

entry.en: The passport must have an expiry date at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe caducar al menos 3 meses después del día en que planeas salir del espacio Schengen.
entry.quote: have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area

entry.en: At Maltese border control you may also need to show a return or onward ticket and prove you have enough money for your stay.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo maltés quizá debas mostrar un billete de vuelta o de continuación y probar que tienes dinero suficiente.
entry.quote:
At Maltese border control, you may also need to:

- show a return or onward ticket

- prove that you have enough money for your stay

entry.en: When entering the Schengen area, you may need to register biometric details such as fingerprints and a photo under the new Entry/Exit System, at no cost.
entry.es: Al entrar en Schengen quizá debas registrar datos biométricos como huellas y foto en el nuevo Sistema de Entradas y Salidas, sin coste.
entry.quote: you may need to register your biometric details, such as fingerprints and a photo. There is no cost for EES registration.

entry.en: You must have a yellow fever vaccination certificate if you are coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.
entry.es: Debes tener un certificado de vacunación contra la fiebre amarilla si vienes de un país con riesgo de transmisión.
entry.quote: To enter Malta, you must have a certificate to prove you’ve had a yellow fever vaccination if you’re coming from a country listed as a transmission risk.

entry.en: Cash or travellers cheques worth 10,000 euros or more must be declared, or the money could be seized when you leave.
entry.es: El efectivo o los cheques de viaje por 10.000 euros o más deben declararse, o el dinero podría ser confiscado al salir.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is 10,000 euros or more. You will get a certified declaration to show you brought it in with you. If you do not, your money could be seized when you leave.

safety.en: Crime against tourists is rare, but there have been incidents of robbery, handbag snatching, pickpocketing and theft from parked cars.
safety.es: El crimen contra turistas es raro, pero ha habido robos, tirones de bolso, carterismo y robos en coches aparcados.
safety.quote:
Crime against tourists is rare, but there have been incidents of:

- robbery

- handbag snatching

- pickpocketing

- theft from parked cars

safety.en: Pickpocketing has happened on bus routes between Valletta and St Julian's, and thieves target crowded buses in summer.
safety.es: Ha habido carterismo en las rutas de autobús entre La Valeta y St Julian's, y los ladrones eligen autobuses llenos en verano.
safety.quote: Pickpocketing has happened on bus routes between Valletta and St Julian’s. Thieves target crowded buses during the summer season.

safety.en: Criminals have drugged people in some bars and gentlemen's clubs in the Paceville district.
safety.es: Delincuentes han drogado a personas en algunos bares y clubes de caballeros del distrito de Paceville.
safety.quote: Criminals have drugged people in some bars and gentlemen’s clubs in the Paceville district.

safety.en: Every year, people drown in the sea and in swimming pools in Malta.
safety.es: Cada año hay personas que se ahogan en el mar y en piscinas en Malta.
safety.quote: Every year, people drown in the sea and in swimming pools in Malta.

safety.en: During the summer lifeguards patrol most beaches with a flag system, where red flags indicate dangerous conditions.
safety.es: En verano, los socorristas vigilan la mayoría de playas con un sistema de banderas, donde las rojas indican condiciones peligrosas.
safety.quote: During the summer, lifeguards patrol most beaches and use a flag safety system. Make sure you understand the system and follow any warnings. Red flags indicate dangerous or hazardous conditions.

safety.en: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, carry severe penalties for tourists.
safety.es: Las drogas ilegales, incluido el cannabis, conllevan penas severas para los turistas.
safety.quote: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, carry severe penalties for tourists.

health.en: To get medically necessary state healthcare in Malta, you need a GHIC or EHIC.
health.es: Para recibir atención sanitaria pública médicamente necesaria en Malta se necesita una tarjeta GHIC o EHIC.
health.quote: To get medically necessary state healthcare in Malta, you need a Global Health Insurance Card (GHIC) or a European Health Insurance Card (EHIC).

health.en: A GHIC or EHIC is not an alternative to travel insurance.
health.es: Una GHIC o EHIC no sustituye al seguro de viaje.
health.quote: A GHIC or EHIC is not an alternative to travel insurance.

health.en: UK prescriptions are not recognised in Malta.
health.es: Las recetas del Reino Unido no se reconocen en Malta.
health.quote: UK prescriptions are not recognised in Malta.

health.en: You can request to see a private GP at most pharmacies.
health.es: Puedes pedir ver a un médico general privado en la mayoría de las farmacias.
health.quote: You can request to see a private GP at most pharmacies.

health.en: Tap water is safe to drink but slightly salty because much of it comes from desalination.
health.es: El agua del grifo es segura para beber pero algo salada porque gran parte procede de desalinización.
health.quote: Water from the tap is safe to drink but has a slightly salty taste to it because much of it is obtained through desalination.

health.en: The main health risk is the fierce sun in spring and summer.
health.es: El principal riesgo para la salud es el sol intenso en primavera y verano.
health.quote: The main health risk in Malta is the fierce sun in the Spring and Summer

help.en: The emergency number for ambulance, fire and police is 112.
help.es: El número de emergencias para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 112.

help.en: The main hospitals are Mater Dei, +356 2545 0000, and Gozo General Hospital, +356 2156 1600.
help.es: Los hospitales principales son Mater Dei, +356 2545 0000, y el Hospital General de Gozo, +356 2156 1600.
help.quote: The main hospitals are Mater Dei Telephone: +356 2545 0000 and Gozo General Hospital in Gozo, +356 2156 1600.

getting_in.en: Malta's sole airport is Malta International Airport in Luqa.
getting_in.es: El único aeropuerto de Malta es el Aeropuerto Internacional de Malta, en Luqa.
getting_in.quote: The nation's sole airport is 1 Malta International Airport (MLA  IATA) (in Luqa).

getting_in.en: Buses to Valletta, Sliema and St. Julian's leave from outside the airport terminal building.
getting_in.es: Los autobuses a La Valeta, Sliema y St. Julian's salen frente a la terminal del aeropuerto.
getting_in.quote: Buses to various locations on the island (Valletta, Sliema, St. Julian's, etc.) are outside the terminal building.

getting_in.en: Official Malta taxis from the airport have fixed rates, described on a board in the arrivals halls.
getting_in.es: Los taxis oficiales desde el aeropuerto tienen tarifas fijas, indicadas en un panel en las llegadas.
getting_in.quote: Official Malta taxis have fixed rates to destinations. These rates should be described on a board in the arrivals halls.

getting_in.en: There are frequent fast ferries from the Sicilian ports of Catania (3 hours) and Pozzallo (90 minutes).
getting_in.es: Hay ferris rápidos frecuentes desde los puertos sicilianos de Catania (3 horas) y Pozzallo (90 minutos).
getting_in.quote: There are frequent fast ferries from the Sicilian ports of Catania (3 hours) and Pozzallo (90 minutes)

getting_in.en: Visitors from outside the EU must fill out a landing card, available in the airport entrance hall.
getting_in.es: Los visitantes de fuera de la UE deben rellenar una tarjeta de aterrizaje, disponible en el vestíbulo del aeropuerto.
getting_in.quote: Visitors from outside the EU, including Americans, must fill out a landing card, available on board some arriving flights (sometimes) or in the entrance hall of the airport

getting_around.en: There is no rail transport of any kind on Malta.
getting_around.es: No hay ningún tipo de transporte ferroviario en Malta.
getting_around.quote: there is no rail transport of any kind

getting_around.en: The Tallinja week pass costs €27 as of summer 2026 and covers any bus across the islands.
getting_around.es: El pase semanal Tallinja cuesta 27 € en el verano de 2026 y cubre cualquier autobús de las islas.
getting_around.quote: The easiest way to enjoy the public transport on Malta is buying a "Tallinja" week pass (€27 as of summer 2026) with which you can take any bus across the islands.

getting_around.en: A single bus fare is €2.50 in summer, €2.00 in winter and €3.00 at night, and drivers cannot give change.
getting_around.es: Un billete sencillo cuesta 2,50 € en verano, 2,00 € en invierno y 3,00 € de noche, y los conductores no pueden dar cambio.
getting_around.quote: A single bus ride fare is €2.50 in the summer (June through October), €2.00 in winter, and €3.00 at night.

getting_around.en: White taxis can pick you up off the street, and Bolt and Uber also operate in Malta.
getting_around.es: Los taxis blancos pueden recogerte en la calle, y Bolt y Uber también operan en Malta.
getting_around.quote: Malta's white taxis are the ones that can pick you up off the street.

getting_around.en: UK driving rules apply in Malta, so you drive on the left side of the road.
getting_around.es: En Malta rigen las normas británicas, por lo que se conduce por la izquierda.
getting_around.quote: UK driving rules apply: drive on the left side of the road.

getting_around.en: A regular ferry runs between Ċirkewwa on Malta and Mġarr on Gozo every 45 minutes in summer.
getting_around.es: Un ferri regular une Ċirkewwa en Malta y Mġarr en Gozo cada 45 minutos en verano.
getting_around.quote: There is the regular ferry service between Ċirkewwa on Malta and Mġarr on Gozo, it goes every 45 minutes in the summer

money.quote: Malta uses the euro, like several other European countries.

money.en: Major currencies other than the euro are not acceptable over the counter, so change dollars or pounds at exchange bureaus or banks.
money.es: Las principales divisas distintas del euro no se aceptan en mostrador, así que cambia dólares o libras en casas de cambio o bancos.
money.quote: Major currencies other than the euro are not acceptable as an over-the-counter currency.

money.en: A Maltese-sized pizza in a decent restaurant costs from €7 to €12.
money.es: Una pizza de tamaño maltés en un restaurante decente cuesta de 7 a 12 €.
money.quote: Having a Maltese-sized pizza in a decent restaurant costs from €7 to €12.

money.en: A bed in a dorm can cost around €15, and a double room in rather cheap hotels around €40.
money.es: Una cama en dormitorio compartido puede costar unos 15 € y una doble en hoteles baratos unos 40 €.
money.quote: A bed in a dorm can cost around €15, and a double room in rather cheap hotels around €40.

etiquette.en: Malta is a strictly Roman Catholic country, and carousing by tourists is not looked on very favourably outside St. Julian's and Paceville.
etiquette.es: Malta es un país estrictamente católico y las juergas de turistas no están bien vistas fuera de St. Julian's y Paceville.
etiquette.quote: Malta is a strictly Roman Catholic country; carousing by tourists, while tolerated to some extent, is not looked on very favourably, especially outside of St. Julian's and Paceville.

etiquette.en: When visiting churches, men must remove hats and sunglasses and everyone should cover knees and shoulders.
etiquette.es: Al visitar iglesias, los hombres deben quitarse sombreros y gafas de sol y todos deben cubrirse rodillas y hombros.
etiquette.quote: Dress respectfully when visiting churches. As a guide, men must remove any hats and sunglasses. Make sure your knees and shoulders are covered.

etiquette.en: You may be refused entry to a church if a Mass has already started.
etiquette.es: Pueden negarte la entrada a una iglesia si ya ha empezado una misa.
etiquette.quote: You may be refused entry to a church if a Mass has already started

etiquette.en: Maltese people tend to speak more loudly, so they may sound like they are shouting even at normal volume.
etiquette.es: Los malteses tienden a hablar más alto, por lo que pueden sonar como si gritaran aunque su volumen sea normal.
etiquette.quote: Maltese people tend to speak more loudly than the mainlanders, so they may sound like they are shouting at you even if the volume is normal.

connectivity.en: Malta has three mobile networks, EPIC, GO Mobile and Melita Mobile, which are likely part of your carrier's roaming plan.
connectivity.es: Malta tiene tres redes móviles, EPIC, GO Mobile y Melita Mobile, que probablemente forman parte del roaming de tu operador.
connectivity.quote: The country has three mobile phone networks available: EPIC, GO Mobile, and Melita Mobile.

connectivity.en: The three mobile networks also offer eSIMs that can be purchased before arrival.
connectivity.es: Las tres redes móviles también ofrecen eSIM que se pueden comprar antes de llegar.
connectivity.quote: The three mobile networks also offer eSIMs that can be purchased before arrival.

connectivity.en: Wi-Fi is almost always available in hotels and hostels, and many cafés and restaurants offer a free connection.
connectivity.es: El wifi casi siempre está disponible en hoteles y hostales, y muchos cafés y restaurantes ofrecen conexión gratuita.
connectivity.quote: Wi-Fi is almost always available in hotels and hostels, and many cafés and restaurants offer a free connection too.
